vectors.name: release-complete-budget
vectors.note: fund, deliver, evaluate, and release the complete budget (§11.1 P1, P6)

vectors.name: evaluator-rejection-refund
vectors.note: a signed post-submission rejection refunds the complete budget (§11.1 P2)

vectors.name: pre-submission-evaluator-rejection
vectors.note: agreement-authorized pre-submission rejection uses a DisputeOutcome and omits delivery evidence (§11.1 P5)

vectors.name: expiry-before-submission
vectors.note: pre-submission expiry refunds without a decision or delivery reference (§11.1 P3)

vectors.name: expiry-after-submission-grace
vectors.note: post-submission expiry refunds at the evaluation deadline without inventing a decision (§11.1 P4)

vectors.name: dreb-15-recovery-after-deadline
vectors.note: DREB-15: expiry recovery after the evaluation deadline remains valid

vectors.name: drd-8-same-terminal-again
vectors.note: DRD-8, DRL-4, DRT-16: verifying the same terminal again reproduces the same evidence and verdict (§11.1 P8)

vectors.name: native-job-id-zero
vectors.note: DRJ-1: native job 0 is minimal unsigned decimal text and names a job

vectors.name: rejected-refund-buyer-fault
vectors.note: DRT-14: a rejected refund with a buyer-fault finding projects buyer failed-perm, seller failed-counterparty (§11.1 P10)

vectors.name: rejected-refund-substrate-failure
vectors.note: DRT-14: a rejected refund with a substrate-failure finding projects failed-substrate for both copies (§11.1 P10)

vectors.name: rejected-refund-no-fault
vectors.note: DRT-14: a rejected refund with a no-fault finding projects no fault (§11.1 P10)

vectors.name: dispute-outcome-release
vectors.note: DRX-9: a seller-fulfilled DisputeOutcome authorizes a post-submission release

vectors.name: post-submission-dispute-refund
vectors.note: DRX-9: a no-fault DisputeOutcome authorizes a post-submission refund

vectors.name: pipeline-missing-terminal
vectors.note: an unpaired escrow phase is rejected

vectors.name: pipeline-actions-reversed
vectors.note: escrow phases must be fund then terminal

vectors.name: pipeline-second-delivery
vectors.note: only one delivery step may occur between the escrow phases

vectors.name: pipeline-extra-payment
vectors.note: ordinary payment phases cannot accompany the pair

vectors.name: pipeline-pay-alternative
vectors.note: a pay-alternative step cannot accompany the pair

vectors.name: pipeline-unsupported-phase-kind
vectors.note: an unsupported phase kind is a candidate §9 step-1 discriminator, which no rule names yet; the DRV-2 label is pending #371's named step-1 rule

vectors.name: pipeline-unprefixed-escrow-kind
vectors.note: DRG-3: `job-escrow` is not the candidate's `x-job-escrow` name, so it is an unknown phase kind

vectors.name: pipeline-commit-phase-missing
vectors.note: the pipeline must commit the agreement and overlay before funding

vectors.name: pipeline-commit-phase-unsupported
vectors.note: an agreementPhase outside DRP-14's two values is an error

vectors.name: pipeline-commit-phase-identity-bound
vectors.note: the identity-bound commit needs the IBH gates, which this pack does not model, so it fails closed

vectors.name: drp-3-attested-payload-delivery-unmodelled
vectors.note: DRP-3: this pack does not model attested-payload delivery, so a success without a DPA-6 attestationRef never verifies

vectors.name: drp-3-entitlement-delivery-unmodelled
vectors.note: DRP-3: this pack does not model entitlement delivery, so it never verifies

vectors.name: pipeline-unsupported-delivery-kind
vectors.note: DRP-3: the one delivery between the escrow steps must be a supported deliver-* kind

vectors.name: pipeline-rail-divergence
vectors.note: both escrow invocations must name the agreement-selected rail

vectors.name: drp-5-escrow-phase-rails
vectors.note: both escrow phases must name the agreement-selected rail

vectors.name: pipeline-delivery-before-final-funding
vectors.note: delivery cannot begin before the funding result is finalized

vectors.name: drv-3-purchase-count-boolean
vectors.note: a boolean purchase count is malformed input, not the count 0

vectors.name: drv-3-purchase-count-float
vectors.note: a float purchase count is malformed input, not the integer count 0

vectors.name: dacs5-volume-before-promotion

vectors.name: pipeline-double-counted-purchase

vectors.name: pipeline-escrow-rail-not-accepted

vectors.name: drr-3-accepted-rail-other-version

vectors.name: pipeline-funding-before-final-commitment

vectors.name: pipeline-agreement-commitment-not-final

vectors.name: pipeline-terminal-before-delivery-return

vectors.name: pipeline-late-delivery-not-disabled
vectors.note: a cutoff refund permanently disables late delivery submission

vectors.name: pipeline-phase-index-divergence
vectors.note: signed indexes must match the phase pair

vectors.name: bilateral-agreement-reference-mismatch

vectors.name: bilateral-agreement-hash-mismatch

vectors.name: bilateral-agreement-seller-unsigned

vectors.name: overlay-signature-roles-repeated

vectors.name: overlay-signature-party-not-role-claim

vectors.name: dra-17-bilateral-parties-swapped

vectors.name: dra-17-seller-bundle-differs

promotionBlockedRules.DRA-12: requires authenticated ordering of the overlay's SR-2 finality before job creation; the pack resolves the overlay but has no evidence of when it was finalized
promotionBlockedRules.DRA-14: requires authenticated native evidence of every later mutation of the bound parties, token, budget, recipient, policy, and deadlines; the pack models no later replacement
promotionBlockedRules.DRAA-3: requires the normative SR-2 logical-to-native binding and a conforming resolver
promotionBlockedRules.DRAA-4: requires authenticated SR-2 write-once behavior from the selected storage binding
promotionBlockedRules.DRAA-5: requires authenticated conflicting-write evidence from the selected SR-2 binding
promotionBlockedRules.DRAA-8: requires an authenticated resolver that selects by logical address rather than index or reported time
promotionBlockedRules.DRAA-9: requires CORE SR2-10 through SR2-12 receipt delivery to the entitled participants
promotionBlockedRules.DRE-7: requires authenticated evidence that the evaluation was anchored before the decision used it
promotionBlockedRules.DREB-17: requires the agreement-bound DACS control proof for the evaluator's EOA
promotionBlockedRules.DREB-24: is a deployment capability (DRC-10 evidence of no trusted forwarder or *WithAuthorization entrypoint) that the deployment pack does not check yet
promotionBlockedRules.DRF-7: requires the session orchestrator to anchor funding evidence through a conforming SR-2 implementation
promotionBlockedRules.DRG-2: is a process rule for the candidate document, which scripts/validate_candidate_profile.py checks
promotionBlockedRules.DRJ-6: requires live proxy, implementation, and mutation-authority resolution for a selected deployment
promotionBlockedRules.DRJ-9: requires the session orchestrator to anchor the job reference through a conforming SR-2 implementation
promotionBlockedRules.DRP-13: concerns an older reader of the candidate phase kinds, which this verifier is not
promotionBlockedRules.DRP-15: requires per-invocation gate evidence for the section 2.3 table
promotionBlockedRules.DRP-16: requires CORE PhaseHandlerResult receipts for the commit and fund invocations
promotionBlockedRules.DRP-17: requires an ok:false invocation and its errorClass
promotionBlockedRules.DRQ-2: requires the explicit-party-supplied evidence shape and deliberate-supply proof to be specified
promotionBlockedRules.DRQ-5: is a future transcript-enabled profile requirement and has no current-profile case
promotionBlockedRules.DRV-5: requires transaction-submission retry orchestration against a live native job
promotionBlockedRules.DRX-3: requires the post-terminal dispute-revision profile, which is outside this first executable pack
promotionBlockedRules.DRX-4: requires a post-terminal dispute revision and authenticated observation of the fixed disposition
promotionBlockedRules.DRX-8: requires artifacts of the output-only DACS-X dispute family to present as this candidate's

promotionBlockedProofs.DRA-4: requires authenticated DACS-1 identity bundles and DACS-2 Vet results, and a control proof for each role's EVM account; the pack binds unsigned fixture role-bundle and Vet-record inputs by hash only
promotionBlockedProofs.DRA-8: requires an authenticated DACS-2 CompositeVerificationRecord for the evaluator's BundleRequirement; the pack compares the requirement hash with an unsigned fixture Vet-record input
promotionBlockedProofs.DRA-9: requires the authenticated DACS-2 composite result and its freshness rule; the pack reads a pass result and a fixture validFromSec/validUntilSec window from an unsigned Vet-record input, which is not the DACS-2 record shape
promotionBlockedProofs.DRE-2: requires the DeliveryEvidence and its deliverable to be finalized and independently resolvable through verified SR-2 receipts (PDE-2, PDE-4); the pack checks the record's shape, phase, addresses, and hashes but has no receipts
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-7: requires the PDE-1 through PDE-8 receipts and session authority behind the DeliveryEvidence; the pack checks the record itself, as for DRE-2
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-9: requires a normative proof shape showing that the exact delivery digest was fixed before the native submission; the pack models it with a synthetic resolver-attested digest anchor
promotionBlockedProofs.DRF-8: requires FV-1 through FV-10 over an AuthenticatedChainObservation for every chain fact; the pack reads block, transaction, and log facts from the pinned fixture resolver and checks their internal consistency
promotionBlockedProofs.DRR-2: requires a registry snapshot for RD-2 through RD-7; the pack verifies the pinned steward's RD-1 signature only
promotionBlockedProofs.DRR-3: requires LRR-1 through LRR-6 resolution of the signed Listing's acceptedRails; the pack checks the orchestrator-stated executionContext.acceptedRails
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-6: requires authenticated evidence that funding finality preceded the delivery step; the pack checks the orchestrator-stated executionContext.fundingFinalizedBeforeDelivery
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-8: requires authenticated DACS-5 bundle and volume accounting for the escrow pair; the pack checks the orchestrator-stated executionContext.dacs5PurchaseCount
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-10: requires authenticated resolution of the signed Listing's acceptedRails selection of the escrow rail; the pack checks the orchestrator-stated executionContext.acceptedRails
promotionBlockedProofs.DRP-11: requires the two verified CORE commit receipts; the pack checks the orchestrator-stated executionContext.commitmentReceipts
